Grip Strength Tracker

Log dynamometer readings and compare against age and gender reference ranges.

Approximate reference ranges for illustration, not clinical cut-offs. For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Select gender and enter your age.
  2. Enter your dynamometer reading in kg and the hand tested.
  3. Click Log reading to compare against the reference range.
  4. Build a history log saved in your browser.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do the reference ranges come from?

Approximate typical ranges for dominant-hand grip by decade. They are illustrative, not clinical cut-offs.

How should I measure?

With a hand dynamometer, arm at your side, elbow at 90 degrees, squeezing maximally. Take the best of 2-3 tries.

Which hand should I test?

Test both, but the reference ranges reflect the dominant hand. Log which hand you used.
